objective: Repair the proven V2.9 lexical discovery selection bias with a deterministic issuer-scoped negative-space supplement while reusing the frozen V2.9 lexical census as the base layer and preserving all downstream E-layer semantics.

parent_findings.interpretation: The 18-term base layer is retained as admissible evidence but is not sufficient as the sole discovery mechanism.

problem_elimination_pass.delete: Do not perform a blank-searchkey census over all development securities.
problem_elimination_pass.avoid: Do not add or tune lexical synonyms using observed positive titles.
problem_elimination_pass.absorb: Reuse the completed V2.9 lexical census and V2.9.1 ranks 1-64 negative-space classifications.
problem_elimination_pass.substitute: Use deterministic issuer batches to supplement only the lexical negative space.
problem_elimination_pass.precompute_reuse: V2.9 base positives and V2.9.1 Batch-1 positives are immutable reusable inputs.
problem_elimination_pass.optimize: Only execute additional 64-security supplement batches until the unchanged information floor passes or the preregistered 256-security supplement bound is exhausted.

invariants.temporal_rule: Asia/Shanghai announcement date must equal official finalpage path date; effective date is first frozen joint A-share session strictly after disclosure date.

supplement_layer.transport: CNINFO issuer-scoped historical announcement query with blank searchkey
supplement_layer.security_order: All fold0/fold1/fold2 canonical_security_id values sorted by SHA256(canonical_security_id), then canonical_security_id.
supplement_layer.candidate_scope: Frozen disclosure range; frozen title triage; only announcement_ids absent from the conservative recovered parent lexical candidate authority are supplement candidates.

sequential_rule.stop_rule: After each complete supplement batch, union immutable V2.9 base positives with all completed supplement positives, dedupe by announcement_id, and evaluate the unchanged information floor. Stop at the first complete batch that passes every floor condition.
sequential_rule.if_batch2_fail: Batch-3 ranks 129-192 may be authorized only by the persisted Batch-2 aggregate receipt.
sequential_rule.if_batch3_fail: Batch-4 ranks 193-256 may be authorized only by the persisted Batch-3 aggregate receipt.

overnight_execution_policy.batch2_execution: 8 sequential chunks x 8 securities; each chunk has a hard workflow timeout and persists independent evidence.
